title: I have definetly had a strange dream involving a mall twice in recent months and my SO even had a dream of one a couple nights ago.
content: In one of mine the rules of regular physics didnt apply and people did over the top things. The other was a normal dream, eat, talk, walk around, etc. My SO said hers involved flying and other fantastical things. I did not know this was normal and other people had these dreams also and I wonder if it's the real mall and we are going there when we get done with "the simulatuon" every night lol.
